dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what should I do in Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You must try khao soi! It's a northern curry with noodles.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈmʌst ˈtraɪ ˈkaʊ ˈsɔɪ! ɪts ə ˈnɔːrðərn ˈkɜːri wɪð ˈnuːdəlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Where can I find good khao soi?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛr kən aɪ ˈfaɪnd ˈɡʊd ˈkaʊ ˈsɔɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Join a food tour. A guide takes you to the best local restaurants.
dialogue.reading: ˈdʒɔɪn ə ˈfuːd ˌtʊr. ə ˈɡaɪd ˈteɪks juː tə ðə ˈbɛst ˈloʊkəl ˈrɛstərɑːnts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sounds great. I'd also like to learn to cook Thai food.
dialogue.reading: ˈsaʊndz ˈɡreɪt. aɪd ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈlaɪk tə ˈlɜːrn tə ˈkʊk ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then you must take a cooking class! You cook five dishes and eat them all.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ˈmʌst ˈteɪk ə ˈkʊkɪŋ ˌklæs! juː ˈkʊk ˈfaɪv ˈdɪʃɪz ənd ˈiːt ðɛm ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And in Bangkok? I only have one more day there.
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk? aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈhæv ˈwʌn ˈmɔːr ˈdeɪ ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You can't miss the floating market. Go early in the morning, before the crowds.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈkænt ˈmɪs ðə ˈfloʊtɪŋ ˈmɑːrkɪt. ˈɡoʊ ˈɜːrli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈkraʊdz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is it far from the city?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈfɑːr frəm ðə ˈsɪti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About two hours by car. When you get back, take a boat trip on the river.
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈtuː ˈaʊərz baɪ ˈkɑːr. wɛn juː ˈɡɛt ˈbæk, ˈteɪk ə ˈboʊt ˌtrɪp ɑːn ðə ˈrɪvər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a long day.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz laɪk ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It is! So in the evening, you must get a Thai massage. You'll feel great.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪz! soʊ ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ, juː ˈmʌst ˈɡɛt ə ˈtaɪ məˈsɑːʒ. juːl ˈfiːl ˈɡreɪt.
